subject: Observability partner: telemetry auth, flow-control & POC alignment
messages:
From: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@datadog.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@grafana.com>
Cc: Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0800
Subject: ACME POC - auth, sampling, and backpressure test plan

Hi all,

Thanks for loop‑in. We put together a first draft of the test plan for the ACME POC (attached: acme-poc-test-plan.xlsx). High-level asks from Datadog side:
- Confirm the instrumentation SDK version and expected OTLP endpoint (host/port + API key method).
- Expected sampling profile for web vs. batch workloads (ACME suggested 1% for traces, 10% for infra metrics).
- How Redwood wants to handle auth/timeouts for our streaming export (we can support API key + short lived token exchange).
- Backpressure/flow-control: we need to validate throttling behavior when ACME replays high concurrency traces (we propose a 5k/s synthetic run).

Can Redwood share an example RTW (receive-time-window) trace bundle and the preferred auth exchange flow for private deployments (ACME will run in their VPC)?

Alex
Datadog Partnerships

---
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@datadog.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@grafana.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 14, 2027 at 10:03 AM -0800
Subject: Re: ACME POC - auth, sampling, and backpressure test plan

Alex — thanks for the draft. Attaching a short matrix of acceptance criteria (rtw-performance-sample.json) and our suggested checkpoints.

Quick responses / next steps:
- Instrumentation: we recommend ACME run latest Redwood OTLP shim (v1.4.2). Ben, confirm SDK compatibility and whether we need a custom header for token swap.
- Auth: we'll support API key and an OAuth token exchange flow. For the POC we can accept API keys scoped to the test namespace; for later Private deploys we'll orchestrate a short‑lived token exchange + KMS.
- Flow control: agree on a staged ramp: 100 -> 1k -> 5k spans/sec. We need explicit SLOs for dropped spans vs. delayed delivery.

Internal ask: Ben/Laura/Tessa — can you review the acceptance matrix and surface any infra/ops blockers by EOD? We want to confirm runbook ownership, fallback routing (Datadog vs. Grafana dashboards), and whether any canary model variants will be required.

I'll propose a 30‑minute technical sync tomorrow 11am PT to align test harnesses.

Thanks,
Dylan
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 14, 2027 at 11:01 AM -0800
Subject: Re: ACME POC - auth, sampling, and backpressure test plan

Looping in technical concerns from the serving/runtime team:
- Batching + kernel selection: when sequence lengths vary (app traces vs. agent metrics) we should pin an execution path to avoid kernel thrash. Recommend we lock max_seq=1024 for the POC to keep profiling stable.
- Token exchange header: our shim expects x-rw-auth: <token> for token swap; API key mode will accept x-rw-api-key. Need confirmation if Datadog will wrap or pass through.
- Rate limiting semantics: Redwood enforces per‑customer qps and a token bucket with retry-after. We'll surface the retry-after header in the POC run so the partners can measure backpressure impact.

Operational asks: can Laura own the canary rollback criteria and Tessa own the customer-facing runbook (steps for ACME SRE if exports stall)?

Ben
Head of Integrations

---
From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@grafana.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@datadog.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, Jan 14, 2027 at 14:42 PM -0800
Subject: Re: ACME POC - auth, sampling, and backpressure test plan

Thanks — Grafana is happy to participate in the joint validation. A few notes from our side:
- We can provision a demo Grafana Cloud org for the POC and pre-seed dashboards. We'll consume metrics via OTLP → Grafana Agent.
- For trace sampling, we prefer deterministic sampling at the proxy (we'll share a small python snippet). If Redwood exposes a sampling hook we can coordinate live toggles during runs.
- Regarding backpressure: Grafana Agent will surface exporter error metrics and a backpressure gauge; we'll link those to Grafana alerts so ACME SRE can see when retransmits occur.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf (redlines inline). We suggest a joint tech run on Tuesday to rehearse the 5k/sec step.

Sara Gomez
Partnerships — Observability Integrations, Grafana Labs

---
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@datadog.com>, Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@grafana.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 02:20 PM -08:00
Subject: Re: ACME POC - auth, sampling, and backpressure test plan

All — thanks for the quick responses and the attachments. Finalizing decisions here so we have a clear runbook: 
1) Auth & endpoints: POC will use API keys for simplicity (x-rw-api-key). For Private deployment phase we'll move to short‑lived token exchange; Ben to coordinate header contract with Alex.
2) Sampling profile: ACME to start with 10% metrics sample / 1% traces; Grafana will enable deterministic proxy sampling for the 5k run.
3) Flow test plan: staged ramp 100/1k/5k spans/sec. Redwood will expose retry-after header; Grafana will emit backpressure metrics to a dedicated dashboard.
4) Ownership: Laura (canary rollback criteria), Tessa (customer runbook), Ben (token/header contract), Dylan (overall POC coordination).
5) Next meetings: Tech dry‑run Tue 2027-01-19 10am PT; Executive synced MTL on Wed if POC shows instability.

References: Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3acme-poc), HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME).

Please ack and I'll send calendar invites.

-Dylan
Sr. Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: acme-poc-test-plan.xlsx, rtw-performance-sample.json, mutual_action_plan_draft.pdf
